text: Appeal of Order to Comply for 54 Peterborough Avenue.

The Property Standards Committee, Etobicoke York Panel: 1. Amended the Order to Comply, dated February 9, 2018, regarding the property located at 54 Peterborough Avenue, to change: (a) Item 4, Section to be 36.F. (b) Item 5, Section to be 36.F. (c) Item 24, Section to be 5.B.2. 2. Confirmed the Order to Comply, dated February 9, 2018, regarding the property located at 54 Peterborough Avenue, for Items 1 to 24 inclusive, and in doing so granted an extension of time to: (a) May 15, 2018 for Items 4, 5, 6, 10 and 19. (b) September 28, 2018 for Items 1 to 3, 7 to 9, 11 to 18, 20 to 24.
